The test image shows banana **fruit (pod)** with dark circular/expanding lesions progressing from small spots to large necrotic areas over 10 days post-inoculation. This is clearly a fruit disease.

The affected part is **pod/fruit**. Classes with pod references: Anthracnose and Cigar_End_Rot. The spreading dark circular lesions on the fruit body (not tip) strongly point to Anthracnose. Let me confirm with one reference.

The reference image confirms Anthracnose on banana fruit: dark circular spots on green fruit skin, exactly matching the early stages in the test image. The test image shows the full progression — small dark spots expanding into large necrotic lesions — which is the hallmark of Anthracnose (caused by *Colletotrichum musae*).

Cigar End Rot would affect the tip of the fruit with mummification, not spreading circular lesions on the fruit body.
